description: What an honor to witness history in the very place we call home. Yesterday, a sitting President came to speak directly to the people of our region. And that made one thing clear: the Hudson Valley matters. Thank you President Donald J. Trump for visiting and Congressman Mike Lawler for catching the attention of our nation and putting our communities in the well-deserved spotlight.
